description: Listen-host half of the B-1064/B-1096/B-1097 reconnect proof. It waits for ordinary live gameplay, retires stable client 1's validated attached right-hand weapon through the production lifecycle, asks ENet to disconnect that client with the real timeout reason in the same harness tick, proves the captured sync ID leaves the authoritative prop pool through normal cleanup, then remains authoritative while that same client authenticates and restores.

input_sequence.comment: Start the peer-dependent deadline only after the ENet listen host is published.
Do not perturb a partial handshake or loading stage.
Enter the shared deleting/non-regenerating held-weapon lifecycle and prove the selected attachment is immediately ineligible for snapshot serialization.
After a bounded post-load margin, require the remote client's real CLC_STAGE_READY and trigger the production timeout path.
After ordinary object ticks but before the client's one-second stable reconnect wait can complete, read the authority pool and require the exact retired sync ID to be gone.
Leave a bounded 90-second window after timeout for stable-slot auth, stage reload, ordered state restore, and gameplay resync.
